test_title: SSC Selection Post HSC Level Official Paper (Held on: 4 Aug 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: In a code language, 'MUSCLE' is coded as USMLEC and 'FINGER' is coded as INFERG. How will 'THROAT' be coded in the same language?
solution:
According to the English alphabets and their positional values:
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2279b560b10991887192eff3a548e57e9b0820d787d416555b032b86f014a220.png] 
The pattern followed in the given series is:

 
• **First alphabet is placed at 3rd place.**
 
• Second alphabet is placed at 1st place.
 
• Third alphabet is placed at 2nd place.
 
• Fourth alphabet is placed at 6th place.
 
• Fifth alphabet is placed at 4th place.
 
• Sixth alphabet is placed at 5th place.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5e0ad86e5714dbae81a669888b252ccc5b8dfbbc997ad9568c542758d97103e9.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/46d44ea323c1f69459874e7d8e5617b7d63f36920f1a2532b6ca0701d3c4e2b1.png] 

Similarly,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f7fd95315e4fa996064325be9ccfccdbef440a0a6d86d5c6a062dbd5f379e33.png] 

Hence **the correct answer is option 4)**
